title: carex muricata subsp. divulsa
intro: Carex muricata subsp. divulsa, commonly known as Rough-leaved Sedge, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the genus Carex, which includes approximately 2000 species of sedges. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including the ability to reduce inflammation and alleviate symptoms associated with respiratory issues such as bronchitis and asthma. The therapeutic actions of Carex muricata subsp. divulsa are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which have antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. However, more research is needed to fully understand the effects and potential applications of this plant, and it should not be used as a substitute for medical treatment without consulting a healthcare professional.
